items.title: Cryptocurrency Stocks Fall in Premarket Trading as Bitcoin Drops Towards $64,600
items.summary: Shares of cryptocurrency-related companies declined in US premarket trading on Monday as Bitcoin (COIN:BTCUSD) extended its recent losses, trading near its lowest level in three months amid concerns about US interest rates and the regulatory outlook for digital assets. Bitcoin was trading at approximately $64,600.

items.title: Trump’s Justice Department Sues Arkansas to Protect Kalshi. That’s Good News for Robinhood
items.summary: Key TakeawaysThe Justice Department and the CFTC sued Arkansas to stop it from enforcing its gambling laws against Kalshi, the exchange that handles an estimated 60% of Robinhood’s prediction-market volume. Federal agencies arguing that these contracts belong to the CFTC lowers the risk on Robinhood’s fastest-growing line, where contracts traded rose 136% in October from a year earlier.
